kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source definitions and panels.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the two definitions, the two dose-response panels, and the partial-agonist sentence; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The two-axis reading (CEILING: efficacy 'Maximal effect a drug can produce (intrinsic activity). Represented by the y-value (Emax)' — partial agonists lower it, and it is 'unrelated to potency'; POSITION: potency 'Amount of drug needed for a given effect. Represented by the x-value (EC50)' — left shift = ↓ EC50 = ↑ potency = ↓ drug needed, and it is 'unrelated to efficacy'; with the geometric rule that Δ Efficacy is a VERTICAL gap between plateaus while Δ Potency is a HORIZONTAL gap between EC50s) — KYP's synthesis of the page's two definitions and two panels into one decision protocol (which axis does the stem describe, and which delta is drawn).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the two definitions and the two panels as parallel blocks without a unified reading protocol; the ceiling-vs-position framing and the vertical-delta / horizontal-delta geometry are KYP's design.

kypExtensions.summary: The four KYP mnemonics (1 — EFFICACY IS THE CEILING, READ THE y-AXIS: the Emax rule; 2 — POTENCY IS THE POSITION, READ THE x-AXIS: the EC50 left-shift rule; 3 — PARTIALS PULL THE CEILING DOWN: the partial-agonist rule; 4 — CEILING ≠ POSITION, THE AXES DON'T TALK: the independence clauses). The page prints NO mnemonic in this section — all four codes are KYP-original designs.
kypExtensions.rationale: Book 232's Efficacy vs potency section prints NO margin mnemonic; all four codes are KYP-original designs.

notes: Census (pdfimages + VLM): NO raster images on the page (pdfimages -list returned zero rows for pdf 254). The section is typeset text plus two vector curve panels: the Efficacy row and Potency row definitions (text layer) and the RELATIVE EFFICACY / RELATIVE POTENCY dose-response panels (vector line-art curves with text labels — drawn curves, not photographs). The two definitions print in the text layer and are carried verbatim in the note's table blocks and re-typeset in the registry visual's definition cards (ORIGINAL_KYP_ADAPTATION) — short attributed definition sentences, not artwork reproductions. The two dose-response curves are redrawn as ORIGINAL_KYP_REDRAW vector line-art sigmoids in the registry visual (full agonist vs partial agonist with different Emax and the same curve position; two full agonists with the same Emax and different EC50) — the curve shapes are the standard Hill sigmoids of pharmacodynamics, re-drawn from scratch; no copyrighted artwork is reproduced. The page prints NO margin mnemonic for this section; the KYP memory layer adds four original codes (EFFICACY IS THE CEILING, POTENCY IS THE POSITION, PARTIALS PULL THE CEILING DOWN, CEILING ≠ POSITION). No copyrighted photographs exist on the page; nothing reproduced. NOTE: page 254 (book 232) contains NO 'Receptor binding' (PH8) and NO 'Therapeutic index' (PH9) content — those sections live on later pages (Receptor binding begins on pdf 255 / book 233) and are separate pending topics, so no exclusion was needed for this topic. NO dosage-calculations (PH6) content appears either — that is pdf 253 / book 231, already produced.
